$schema-note: Adapter inputs for one corpus build. `corpus build --inputs <path>` reads this file. Every `inputPath` and `streetIndex` is relative to $MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, resolved at launch.
$overlay-note: The one source this build rebuilds replaces its v0.8.10-overlay files in an overlay on that corpus. `geonames-features` renders one feature in GEONAMES_FEATURES_WITH_COUNTRY_DIVISOR with its country, so its `venue -> country` rows fall below the corpus's `locality -> country` rows (#2904).
